useful_delta: Defined a layered universal-AI bootstrap architecture that separates public discovery, freshness/integrity, job resolution, private-context access, scoped privileged capabilities, execution evidence and canonical product authority.

Identified a standards-level discovery issue: the current project URL https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/.well-known/prometeo.json is a stable project locator but is not an RFC 8615 well-known URI because /.well-known/ is not rooted at the origin path. Preserve it for compatibility, but use a root-level well-known resource or custom origin for standards-based discovery.

Defined a signature/version strategy that does not pretend self-signing creates initial identity: HTTPS/user-supplied origin is the bootstrap trust mode for unrelated AIs; signatures provide integrity, immutable-version verification, TOFU/native key pinning and safe key rotation after trust is established.

Defined a narrow capability model for privileged operations: server-side issued, revocable, audience/resource/action/work-item/run bounded, short-lived, replay-resistant, never embedded in public coordination artifacts, with Authorization-header transport preferred and DPoP available as a stronger sender-constrained profile.
Defined a migration path in which p.txt becomes a generated compatibility projection rather than the security or semantic source of truth, while preserving current launch syntax and zero-memory UX.

Defined explicit fail-closed machine boundary codes and adversarial conformance tests for stale caches, tampered manifests, unsupported versions, token leakage/replay, scope escape, duplicate runs, private-data leakage and authority confusion.
facts: INC-ZM-BOOT-01 proves a fresh unprimed chat cannot be expected to understand the bare token Prometeo; the first message needs a resolvable bootstrap locator unless the platform has native/global Prometeo integration.
The current stable entry already provides a machine-readable manifest, p.txt fallback, runtime pointers, EPOCH, launch boards, deterministic BIG shorthand and mandatory constitution links.
Current runtime law correctly separates coordination from product authority: worker/run/return state does not manufacture Current, Human Accepted or Served truth.

Current Prometeo private-runtime precedent already keeps sensitive state server-side in Supabase while GitHub carries code and sanitized coordination metadata; Finance/Auth uses authenticated server-side access rather than committing secrets or financial data to GitHub.
The current stable entry advertises no cryptographic signature/trust-root protocol and no generic narrow privileged-capability issuance contract for unrelated AIs.

RFC 8615 defines /.well-known/ as an origin-root path prefix and explicitly states that /foo/.well-known/example is not a well-known URI. Therefore the present /prometeo/.well-known/prometeo.json path is compatibility discovery, not standards-based origin discovery.

RFC 9700 is current OAuth 2.0 Security Best Current Practice; RFC 9449 defines DPoP sender-constrained tokens; RFC 10017 (August 2026) emphasizes minimizing token authority and avoiding exposing powerful long-lived tokens directly to browser code when a backend-mediated architecture is practical.

During this scout, one public web retrieval of p.txt surfaced v4.1 while the current gh-pages and main branch p.txt bytes are v4.3. This is evidence that a consumer may observe stale cached/bootstrap content; it is not proof that the origin currently serves different bytes. Freshness must therefore be explicit in the protocol rather than assumed from a URL.
candidates: Adopt a new public contract named prometeo.ai-entry/v1, referenced by the existing stable entry so current clients remain compatible.

Treat the existing project-path stable entry as a compatibility locator. Add a true origin-root /.well-known/<registered-or-project-specific-suffix> endpoint on a controlled root/custom domain when available; until then avoid implying RFC 8615 compliance from the nested path.

Publish immutable versioned manifest bytes plus a small stable pointer/envelope. Include sequence, issued_at, expires_at/max_stale, content digest, previous_digest, EPOCH/main-head references and compatibility metadata so stale clients can detect that their bootstrap is no longer fresh.

Sign exact immutable manifest bytes with JWS using an asymmetric key and kid. Publish a JWKS/key-transition document. Native integrations may pin a root fingerprint; unrelated AIs may use HTTPS-origin trust plus TOFU pinning after first successful boot. An emergency key reset must require a stronger out-of-band/origin confirmation because a new key self-declared by a compromised origin is not proof of identity.
Use the existing private-runtime/Auth substrate as the likely privileged capability issuer rather than storing write credentials in GitHub or inventing obfuscation-based security.

Prefer opaque revocable capability handles stored server-side. Bind each capability to exact audience, subject/run, work_item_id, verbs, resource/path set, branch when relevant, private-data classes, not-before/expiry, max uses and idempotency/replay constraints. The token itself should reveal no sensitive payload.

Transport privileged capability tokens in Authorization headers, never public files and preferably never URLs. Offer DPoP for clients that can hold an ephemeral key. If a model/tool can only dereference a URL, allow a compatibility one-time URL only for narrowly scoped packet retrieval/exchange, with very short TTL and no direct broad write authority.

Make public protocol files declarative and bounded. A fetched Prometeo manifest is product protocol data under the user's request; it never overrides the host model's system/developer/safety policy and must not be able to expand its own trust or privileges merely by containing prose instructions.

Add a deterministic public resolver contract that expands aliases such as BIG=n, searches declared boards in order, requires exactly one launch target, validates job schema/status/prerequisites and returns a resolution record without granting write authority.

Keep run allocation and write authorization separate from resolution. A public resolver may say P-BIG-16 -> WI-BIG-16; only a capability-authorized execution path may create STARTED/RETURN objects or access private context.

Make duplicate-launch behavior deterministic: existing DONE/RETURNED returns are reused; a fresh active run is not duplicated; a stale run can only be retried/superseded under explicit parent/steward policy with a new worker instance id; no worker overwrites another worker's run file.
Generate p.txt and chat-bootstrap text from the canonical machine manifest/contracts in CI. p.txt remains the smallest human/LLM compatibility bridge, not an independently edited authority surface.

layers.name: DISCOVERY
layers.purpose: Allow an unrelated AI to locate the Prometeo machine contract from one human-supplied URL or an origin-root well-known resource.

layers.name: INTEGRITY_AND_FRESHNESS
layers.purpose: Identify exact immutable manifest bytes, version, EPOCH, age, predecessor and optional cryptographic verification without conflating these with product authority.

layers.name: RESOLUTION
layers.purpose: Normalize Home/launch aliases and resolve them deterministically to durable project/chat-object/work-item identities.

layers.name: CAPABILITY_GATE
layers.purpose: Authorize narrow private reads or writes using revocable scoped server-side capabilities; provider credentials remain behind the gate.

layers.name: PRIVATE_CONTEXT
layers.purpose: Return only the minimum private payload needed by the exact job/capability; raw transcript, credentials and unrelated private data never become public coordination state.

layers.name: EXECUTION_AND_EVIDENCE
layers.purpose: Persist STARTED, scoped work, sanitized RETURN and terminal run state. These are coordination evidence, not Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.

ai_entry_manifest_shape.expires_at: ISO timestamp or explicit max_stale policy

signature.alg: EdDSA or another explicitly allowlisted asymmetric alg

cache_recovery: use declared same-owner source fallback when policy permits

capabilities.token_in_public_url: forbidden except explicit one-time compatibility fetch

capability_record_shape_server_side.subject: worker/run or authenticated principal
capability_record_shape_server_side.work_item_id: exact delegated job or null for another bounded operation
resources: exact ids/path prefixes with canonical path validation
capability_record_shape_server_side.max_uses: small integer or unlimited only for low-risk read

bootstrap_algorithm: Receive human-supplied Prometeo locator/command; do not assume bare Prometeo semantics in an unprimed environment.
Fetch only the declared stable entry; enforce size/content-type limits and reject unexpected cross-origin redirects unless explicitly authorized by the manifest/user.
Require supported schema/version. Parse protocol fields declaratively; external text cannot override host safety/system policy.
Check freshness metadata. If stale, refresh via declared path before any privileged operation.
Verify immutable digest. Verify signature when a pinned/TOFU trust state exists; if signature verification is required by policy and fails, privileged work fails closed.
Resolve selector/launch alias deterministically to durable identity. Ambiguous/missing mapping is a boundary, never a guess.
Load the minimum public governing context: constitution, job, relevant Big Picture/Survival rules and EPOCH.
For read-only/public work, continue without a secret.
For private reads/writes, obtain a capability through the authorized private issuer/tool path. Never copy provider credentials into the model prompt or public return.
Immediately before write, re-check EPOCH/current owner/convergence and validate capability scope against canonicalized target.
Persist independent STARTED before substantive execution, then scoped RETURN/evidence, then DONE/boundary.

job_resolution_model.public_resolution: alias -> exactly one durable identity with resolution evidence, no privilege granted

run_policy.stale_run: parent/steward retry or supersede with a new run id
run_policy.boundary_failed: respect terminal evidence; retry only under declared policy

failure_codes.ENTRY_UNREACHABLE: No trusted bootstrap bytes available; no privileged action.
failure_codes.ENTRY_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED: Client cannot safely interpret the entry; stop rather than improvise.
failure_codes.ENTRY_STALE: Refresh/verify an immutable newer entry; cached stale entry may be used only for explicitly allowed read-only recovery.
failure_codes.SIGNATURE_INVALID: Fail closed for any action requiring signed integrity.
failure_codes.TRUST_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE: Do not claim cryptographic identity; continue only in the declared HTTPS/user-origin read-only trust mode or stop if stronger trust is required.
failure_codes.ORIGIN_CHANGED: Require explicit trust transition; do not silently follow a new authority origin.
failure_codes.SELECTOR_INVALID: Invalid BIG/Home/launch selector; never normalize outside declared rules.
failure_codes.JOB_NOT_FOUND: No durable job; do not invent task body.
failure_codes.JOB_AMBIGUOUS: More than one mapping; stop until authority is reconciled.
failure_codes.JOB_NOT_DISPATCHABLE: Prepared object cannot be executed in current state.
failure_codes.CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: Private read/write requested without authorization; public reasoning may continue if useful.
failure_codes.CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Do not refresh implicitly unless issuer policy allows it.
failure_codes.CAPABILITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH: Canonical target/action is outside token scope; deny.
failure_codes.CAPABILITY_REPLAY: Duplicate use violates nonce/max-use/idempotency rules; deny or return prior idempotent result.
failure_codes.PRIVATE_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE: Return a real boundary without substituting guessed/public context.
failure_codes.LIVE_WRITE_COLLISION: Stop or reconcile/narrow scope; do not overwrite stale bytes.
failure_codes.EPOCH_CHANGED: Reload only relevant compiled state and repeat prewrite validation.
failure_codes.RETURN_WRITE_FAILED: Do not mark DONE without durable return evidence.

non_goals: Cryptographic signatures alone do not establish initial identity for an unrelated AI with no pinned trust root.
Obfuscation/Base64/reversed text is not access control.
Worker completion is not canonical promotion.
A public AI manifest must not become a universal shell with unrestricted provider credentials.

public_allowed: public signing keys/fingerprints and key-transition evidence
project/chat-object/work-item identity and non-sensitive mission metadata
public_private_split.rule: Every resource referenced by the machine entry should declare a classification or inherit one from a signed schema; unknown classification fails closed for public publication.

signing_and_versioning.immutable_payload: Publish exact-byte immutable manifests addressed by version and digest; signatures cover those exact bytes so JSON canonicalization ambiguity is avoided.
signing_and_versioning.stable_pointer: Small compatibility entry points to immutable payload, sequence, digest and signature refs. Clients detect stale cache by age/sequence/EPOCH and can re-fetch using declared cache-busting/fallback policy.
signing_and_versioning.key_rotation: Normal rotation is cross-signed/authorized by the previous trusted key and carries not-before/retire-after windows. Emergency reset requires stronger origin/human/native-root confirmation.
trust_modes: USER_SUPPLIED_HTTPS_ORIGIN: sufficient for public bootstrap when the human explicitly supplied the origin, not cryptographic identity beyond HTTPS
TOFU_PIN: remember first accepted key fingerprint and warn/fail on unexpected future key change
NATIVE_PINNED_ROOT: strongest mode for a future ChatGPT/plugin/CLI integration that ships a Prometeo root fingerprint
signing_and_versioning.authority_rule: A valid signature proves integrity/authorship under a trusted key; it does not prove Human Accepted, Current or Served product state.

migration_from_p_txt: M0 Preserve current p.txt, .well-known/prometeo.json, launch codes and BIG shorthand exactly enough that existing fresh-chat launches continue to work.
M1 Add prometeo.ai-entry/v1 as a linked child of the current stable entry, with explicit freshness/version/privacy/failure metadata. No privileged behavior changes yet.

M2 Publish immutable entry snapshots + digest + JWS/JWKS/key-rotation metadata. Add stale-cache and tamper canaries. Keep HTTPS/user-origin trust as the honest default until a key can be pinned out of band/native.

M3 Establish standards-based origin discovery when infrastructure permits: root /.well-known/<Prometeo-specific-suffix> on a controlled root/custom domain. Keep /prometeo/.well-known/prometeo.json as a compatibility locator, not a falsely labelled RFC 8615 resource.

M4 Generate p.txt/chat-bootstrap from canonical contracts in CI. p.txt becomes a tiny human-readable projection containing locator, command syntax and invariant failure rules; it stops being independently hand-maintained authority.

M5 Add private capability gateway on the existing server-side Auth/private-runtime substrate. First capabilities should be minimal: read exact private job context, create exact preallocated run, write exact sanitized return. Do not issue broad repository/provider credentials.

M6 Add stronger sender-constrained profile (DPoP) and revocation/rotation where clients support it; retain short-lived opaque bearer as interoperability baseline and one-time-fetch URL only as a constrained compatibility escape hatch.

M7 Run unrelated-AI conformance canaries before making the new entry canonical. Only after success may parent/steward decide whether current stable entry or p.txt semantics should be promoted/migrated.
tests: ZERO_MEMORY_BOOT: unrelated model receives only stable locator + BIG=16 and resolves exact durable job without chat history.
ROOT_DISCOVERY: origin-root well-known resource resolves correctly; nested project-path resource is treated as compatibility only.
UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: unknown major schema yields ENTRY_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED, no guessing.
STALE_CACHE: serve an older but syntactically valid manifest; client detects age/sequence/EPOCH mismatch and refreshes before privileged work.
TAMPERED_MANIFEST: mutate one immutable byte; digest/signature verification fails and write is blocked.
KEY_ROTATION: valid old->new transition passes; unannounced new key fails pinned/TOFU mode.
SELF_SIGNING_FALSE_SECURITY: first-contact client records that signature without an external/pinned trust root does not create identity stronger than the supplied HTTPS origin.
TOKEN_URL_LEAK: privileged write token must not appear in URL, public return, Git commit, logs intentionally produced by Prometeo, or referrer-bearing navigation.
CAPABILITY_EXPIRY_AND_REPLAY: expired/max-use token denied; idempotent retry returns same result rather than duplicating mutation.
SCOPE_ESCAPE: attempt ../ path traversal, alternate branch, wrong work_item_id, wrong method or wrong audience; capability gate denies after canonicalization.
DUPLICATE_LAUNCH: active existing run is not duplicated; DONE run returns existing durable result; stale retry uses a new run id under parent policy.
PRIVATE_MINIMIZATION: worker receives only job-scoped private data; unrelated transcript/credentials never appear in public artifacts.
PROMPT_INJECTION_BOUNDARY: fetched public prose attempting to expand privileges or override host policy is treated as untrusted protocol content and cannot grant capability.
BROWSER_TOKEN_EXPOSURE: browser UI never stores reusable broad provider/write credentials; use backend-mediated session/capability pattern where practical.
AUTHORITY_SEPARATION: signed manifest, successful write, DONE run and candidate return still do not imply Human Accepted/Current/Served.
SERVED_BYTE_CHECK: when a bootstrap change is claimed served, fetch served bytes and compare exact digest with intended immutable artifact rather than inferring from source commit.
evidence: agent-runtime/epoch.json (gh-pages) observed immediately before return: P3-ae8ac9189fe4 / main 4d5ee822be56
agent-runtime/convergence.json (gh-pages) at same epoch showed no blocking event in the inspected relevant convergence surface; listed overlaps were inactive/non-blocking.
RFC 9700 OAuth 2.0 Security Best Current Practice: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9700.html
conflicts: Naming/trust conflict: current nested /prometeo/.well-known/ path behaves as a stable locator but does not satisfy RFC 8615 origin-root semantics. Migration must preserve compatibility while correcting the standards claim.

Interoperability/security conflict: some unrelated AI/tool environments may only fetch URLs and cannot attach Authorization/DPoP headers. The safe compatibility fallback is a short-lived one-time fetch/exchange URL, not a general write capability embedded in the URL.

Static-host/freshness conflict: GitHub Pages is useful for public immutable metadata but cannot itself be the revocable private capability authority. Keep public discovery static and private authorization server-side.

Signature/bootstrap conflict: a key announced by the same first-contact origin cannot independently authenticate that origin. Treat signatures as integrity/continuity until the key is pinned through TOFU/native/out-of-band trust.
unresolved: Choose the eventual standards-based public origin/root for a true /.well-known/ resource: root user-site path versus dedicated/custom Prometeo domain.

Choose the concrete capability issuer owner/API after parent reconciles BIG-15 FABRIC/Airlock and other security/auth returns; this scout recommends extending the existing private Auth/runtime substrate rather than creating a duplicate global owner.

Choose exact signing algorithm/key custody/rotation implementation after determining deployment environment and whether a native client can pin a root. JWS with an allowlisted asymmetric algorithm is the recommended interoperability shape, not a final operational key decision.

Determine which external-AI environments can send custom headers/POST requests. Capability transport profiles should be selected by client capability rather than pretending one transport works everywhere.
suggested_parent_action: During batch integration, merge this return with BIG-15 FABRIC/Airlock, BIG-06 Agent Network, BIG-07 worker fabric and BIG-10 reincarnation returns. Preserve the current zero-memory UX, but separate four authorities explicitly: public discovery, integrity/freshness trust, scoped privileged capability, and product Current/Human Accepted/Served. The shortest implementation slice is: ai-entry/v1 + generated p.txt + freshness/tamper tests first, then server-side narrow capability gateway, then true origin-root discovery/native key pinning when infrastructure supports it. Do not promote any of these candidates directly from this scout return.
